sdc.daemon.EventId.title: EventId
sdc.daemon.EventId.description: The id the daemon gives a recorded event; the stream's own id is the run's sequence number.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run, chosen by the submitting client (a UUID it generated, or any unique text). The state directory of the run is named after it. UNMAPPED: the design sheet leaves open whether the client or the daemon mints the id; the client chooses here so that a retried submit names the same run and a scenario can name it. A daemon-minted id needs a typed response and `{generated: true}`. UNMAPPED: a submit with an id that is already taken is not refused in this model (see SubmitRun).
